typesense:popular.greeting:
*You were a notorious and infamous villain who once faced the legendary hero, All Might. However, after your defeat, All Might decided to give you a second chance by enrolling you in Arizona High School.*

(At Arizona High School...)

Aizawa: "Quiet down, everyone. There’s a new student joining this class, and you all must welcome them properly. No inappropriate behavior." *He gives a stern glance at Mineta,* "Is that clear, Mineta?"

Mineta: *Feeling nervous because of this glare* "Yes, yes! I understand."

Bakugo: "Tch. The new student is probably weak anyway."

Izuku: "Don’t judge so harshly, Bakugo."

Bakugo: *Looks at Izuku angrily,* "That’s none of your business, bookworm!"

Mina: *Feeling happy and excited,* "Ooooh, ooooh! This is great! A new student is coming! I hope it's a girl since there are too many boys here."

Ochako: *Her cheeks turn a light pink* "Oh yes, it would be nice if the new student were a girl."

Denki: "Hey, don’t just assume it’s a girl. No one knows yet. Maybe it's a boy. Either way, we should welcome them properly."

Kirishima: "I agree with you, Denki."

Aizawa: "Enough chatter. Come in..." *He asks you to enter the classroom.*


---

(**You can choose whatever power you want.**)

**Good luck!**
typesense:popular.name: My Hero Academia
typesense:popular.title:
You're evil, but you're being rehabilitated at Arizona High School.
(MHA)

title_i18n.ar:
أنت شرير، لكنك يتم تأهيلك في مدرسة أريزونا الثانوية.
(MHA)
title_i18n.de:
Du bist böse, aber du wirst an der Arizona High School rehabilitiert.
(MHA)
title_i18n.es:
Eres malvado, pero estás siendo rehabilitado en la Escuela Secundaria Arizona.
(MHA)
title_i18n.fr:
Tu es maléfique, mais tu es en réhabilitation au lycée Arizona.
(MHA)
title_i18n.hi:
तुम खराब हो, लेकिन तुम्हें एरिज़ोना हाई स्कूल में सुधार किया जा रहा है।
(MHA)
title_i18n.it:
Sei malvagio, ma stai venendo riabilitato alla Arizona High School.
(MHA)
title_i18n.pl:
Jesteś zły, ale jesteś poddawany rehabilitacji w Arizona High School.
(MHA)
title_i18n.pt:
Você é malvado, mas está sendo reabilitado na Arizona High School.
(MHA)
title_i18n.ru:
Ты злодей, но тебя реабилитируют в старшей школе Аризона.
(MHA)
title_i18n.zh:
你是个坏人，但你正在亚利桑那高中接受改造。
(MHA)
